# Denetflix

> Denetflix is a free, zero-login independent retro cinema discovery web application dedicated to rare, cult, midnight, and underseen genre films from 1960 to 1999 across American, Italian, European, and Asian cinema.

Denetflix was created by Jacopo Coccia as an antidote to homogeneous streaming-platform recommendation algorithms. Instead of serving repetitive mainstream hits, Denetflix guides viewers through a fast 5-question interactive quiz and surfaces all matching retro genre deep cuts—complete with movie-specific pros and caveats, regional streaming availability checks, verified trailers, and physical media links (Blu-ray, 4K UHD, DVD).

## Key Facts
- **Category**: Independent & Cult Cinema Discovery Web Application
- **Era Covered**: Strictly 1960–1999 (1960s, 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s)
- **Regions Covered**: Global mix, Italy only (giallo, poliziotteschi, commedia, horror), United States only (drive-in, midnight VHS, indie cult), Rest of Europe only (French, British, German, Spanish, Czech, Scandinavian), and Japan & Asia only (Japanese, Hong Kong, Korean, Taiwanese cult cinema)
- **Genres Supported (13)**: Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Fantasy, Horror, Thriller, Romance, Adventure, Crime, Family, Musical, War, Mystery
- **Discovery Workflow**: 5 streamlined steps — Decade, Genres (up to 3), Production Country/Origin, Living-Room Mood/Vibe (ranking priority), and Explicit Deal-Breaker Exclusions
- **Pricing & Access**: 100% free, no user accounts, no sign-up walls, session-only quiz processing (third-party measurement tags managed via Google Tag Manager are disclosed in the Privacy & Cookie Policy)
- **Author**: Jacopo Coccia (https://www.jacopococcia.com)

## Core Pages & Resources
- [Denetflix App](/): Interactive 5-question retro cinema quiz and paginated movie discovery engine
- [Privacy & Cookie Policy](/privacy.html): Privacy policy, cookie & tag inventory (Google Tag Manager, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Google Conversion Linker, Meta Pixel), third-party data sources, and Amazon Associates disclosure
- [Extended LLM Documentation](/llms-full.txt): Detailed guide covering Denetflix's ranking methodology, catalog data sources, genres, and FAQs for AI assistants and search engines

## Data Integrity & Verification
- **Catalog Discovery**: Combines live regional JustWatch GraphQL catalogs (US, IT, GB, FR, DE, JP storefronts), Wikidata SPARQL filmography records, Internet Archive feature films, optional TMDB discovery, and a curated vault of verified 1960–1999 cult films.
- **Availability & Media**: Streaming/rental/purchase providers are checked live by selected country (13 supported regions). When live availability cannot be verified, Denetflix discloses that explicitly rather than fabricating streaming offers.
- **Physical Media**: Links to Blu-ray, 4K UHD, and DVD editions via Amazon.com (international regions) and Amazon.it (Italy).
